_metadata.note: Approximate uncompressed sizes for CUDA base image variants. These are order-of-magnitude values used to estimate savings, not exact per-tag sizes. Keyed on variant rather than tag because the nvidia/cuda tag space (CUDA patch x variant x cuDNN x distro) is combinatorial and changes monthly, while the ratio between variants has been stable for years.
_metadata.source: nvidia/cuda published image sizes, ubuntu22.04 line

base.description: CUDA runtime libraries only, no cuDNN or toolkit

devel.description: Full CUDA toolkit including nvcc, headers and static libraries
